contentData.title: Part 1: Photographs
contentData.instruction: For each question in this part, you will hear four statements about a picture. Choose the statement that best describes what you see in the picture.

questions.question_text: [Photo 1: A woman working at a computer desk near a large window]

options.text: She is typing on a keyboard.
She is closing the office blinds.
She is drinking from a coffee mug.
She is organizing folders on a shelf.

questions.explanation:
Phân tích: Trong bức tranh, người phụ nữ đang đặt hai tay lên bàn phím và nhìn vào màn hình máy tính.
Đáp án đúng là A (She is typing on a keyboard).

questions.question_text: [Photo 2: Construction workers wearing safety helmets reviewing blueprints]

options.text: They are climbing down a ladder.

questions.explanation:
Phân tích: Các công nhân đang cùng nhau nhìn vào bản thiết kế (blueprints / architectural plans).
Đáp án đúng là B.

contentData.title: Part 2: Question-Response
contentData.instruction: You will hear a question or statement and three responses spoken in English. Select the best response to the question or statement.

questions.question_text: Where did you leave the keys to the conference room?

options.text: Yes, we reserved it for 2 PM.

questions.explanation: Phân tích: Câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng từ để hỏi 'Where' (Ở đâu?). Câu trả lời chỉ địa điểm là A (On Ms. Davis's reception desk).

questions.question_text: When will the quarterly financial report be published?

options.text: By the end of next week.

questions.explanation: Phân tích: Câu hỏi thời gian 'When' (Khi nào?). Đáp án phù hợp về thời gian là A (By the end of next week).

contentData.title: Part 5: Incomplete Sentences
contentData.instruction: A word or phrase is missing in each of the sentences below. Four answer choices are given below each sentence. Select the best answer to complete the sentence.

questions.question_text: Mr. Henderson reviewed the annual proposal _______ before submitting it to the executive board.
questions.explanation:
Ngữ pháp: Động từ 'reviewed' cần một trạng từ (adverb) đứng sau để bổ nghĩa cho hành động duyệt hồ sơ.
Đáp án đúng là trạng từ có đuôi '-ly': thoroughly.

questions.question_text: All passengers are advised to keep their boarding passes _______ throughout the security checkpoint.
questions.explanation:
Ngữ pháp: Cấu trúc 'keep + object + adjective' (giữ cho cái gì ở trạng thái như thế nào).
'accessible' (tính từ: có sẵn, dễ lấy) là đáp án chính xác A.

contentData.title: Part 7: Reading Comprehension
contentData.instruction: Read a selection of texts and choose the best answer to each question.
contentData.passage:
To: All Staff <staff@novatech.com>
From: IT Support <support@novatech.com>
Date: October 5, 2026
Subject: Scheduled Cloud Server Maintenance

Please be aware that our primary database server will undergo scheduled maintenance this Saturday, October 10, between 1:00 AM and 5:00 AM UTC. During this 4-hour window, internal tools and file storage will be temporarily offline. Please ensure all unsaved documents are synchronized prior to Friday evening.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the email?

options.text: To announce new IT hiring policies
To notify employees about server maintenance
To request feedback on cloud software
To celebrate a successful system upgrade

questions.explanation: Phân tích: Tiêu đề thư là 'Scheduled Cloud Server Maintenance' và nội dung nói về thời gian bảo trì hệ thống. Đáp án đúng là B.
